_doc: Seat frames for the owner's meeting (console/meeting.js): what each company FUNCTION (loops.json functions) cares about, so every turn names the speaker's own frame and what the others in the room need from it. Keyed by function, never by a seat or a line of business. A company may override any entry in company/work/meetings/frames.json (merged by function). A seat that holds no function speaks from its title.

ceo.label: Direction
ceo.needs: what it changes in the plan, the priorities and who decides

finance.label: Finance
finance.needs: what it costs, what it does to cash, and whether it is inside the limits

risk.label: Risk and legal
risk.needs: the exposure, and any commitment or promise it makes for the company

tools.label: Tools and IT
tools.needs: what has to change in how things run, and who builds and checks it

people.label: People
people.needs: who is affected, whose work moves, and whether anyone is overloaded

floor.label: Floor
floor.needs: who is busy now and what has to move to make room
